3616.title: Automation execution directory ignores the caller project
3616.rootCauseOneLine: The runner forces cwd to plugin script storage, while its outcome mapper summarizes failures using only the exit code.
3616.proposedFix: Define source-host and checkout selection, then resolve cwd; preserve stderr for useful summaries.
3616.caveats: Runner-level reproduction using bash/cat; no desktop or actual project API flow. No PR because source-host and fallback behavior requires a product decision.
